<?php

class SecureConnectionPool {
    private array $pool = [];
    private int $maxConnections = 10;
    private array $connectionMetadata = [];
    
    public function acquire(string $identifier): Connection {
        if (isset($this->pool[$identifier]) && $this->pool[$identifier]->isAlive()) {
            return $this->pool[$identifier];
        }
        $conn = new Connection($identifier);
        $this->pool[$identifier] = $conn;
        $this->connectionMetadata[$identifier] = [
            'created_at' => time(),
            'last_used' => time()
        ];
        if (count($this->pool) > $this->maxConnections) {
            $this->evictOldest();
        }
        return $conn;
    }
    
    private function evictOldest(): void {
        $oldest = null;
        $oldestTime = PHP_INT_MAX;
        foreach ($this->connectionMetadata as $id => $meta) {
            if ($meta['last_used'] < $oldestTime) {
                $oldestTime = $meta['last_used'];
                $oldest = $id;
            }
        }
        if ($oldest !== null) {
            $this->pool[$oldest]->close();
            unset($this->pool[$oldest]);
            unset($this->connectionMetadata[$oldest]);
        }
    }
    
    public function release(string $identifier): void {
        if (isset($this->connectionMetadata[$identifier])) {
            $this->connectionMetadata[$identifier]['last_used'] = time();
        }
    }
}

class CryptoContext {
    private string $masterKey;
    private array $derivedKeys = [];
    private string $lastError = '';
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
    }
    
    public function deriveKey(string $salt, string $info): string {
        $cacheKey = hash('sha256', $salt . $info);
        if (isset($this->derivedKeys[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->derivedKeys[$cacheKey];
        }
        $derived = hash_hkdf('sha256', $this->masterKey, 32, $info, $salt);
        if ($derived === false) {
            $this->lastError = "Key derivation failed for salt=" . bin2hex($salt);
            throw new CryptoException($this->lastError);
        }
        $this->derivedKeys[$cacheKey] = $derived;
        return $derived;
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext, string $key): string {
        $iv = random_bytes(16);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, 'aes-256-gcm', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16);
        if ($ciphertext === false) {
            throw new CryptoException('Encryption failed');
        }
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ciphertext);
    }
    
    public function decrypt(string $encoded, string $key): string {
        $data = base64_decode($encoded, true);
        if ($data === false || strlen($data) < 32) {
            throw new CryptoException('Invalid ciphertext format');
        }
        $iv = substr($data, 0, 16);
        $tag = substr($data, 16, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($data, 32);
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-gcm', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16);
        if ($plaintext === false) {
            throw new CryptoException('Decryption failed - authentication error');
        }
        return $plaintext;
    }
    
    public function __debugInfo(): array {
        return [
            'derivedKeyCount' => count($this->derivedKeys),
            'lastError' => $this->lastError
        ];
    }
}

class SecureCryptoService {
    private SecureConnectionPool $pool;
    private CryptoContext $cryptoCtx;
    private array $operationLog = [];
    private int $maxLogEntries = 1000;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        $this->pool = new SecureConnectionPool();
        $this->cryptoCtx = new CryptoContext($masterKey);
    }
    
    public function processRequest(string $clientId, string $operation, array $params): array {
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire($clientId);
        $startTime = hrtime(true);
        
        try {
            $result = match($operation) {
                'encrypt' => $this->handleEncrypt($params, $clientId),
                'decrypt' => $this->handleDecrypt($params, $clientId),
                'rotate_key' => $this->handleKeyRotation($params, $clientId),
                default => throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unknown operation: $operation")
            };
            
            $elapsed = (hrtime(true) - $startTime) / 1e6;
            $this->logOperation($clientId, $operation, $elapsed, true);
            
            return ['success' => true, 'data' => $result];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $elapsed = (hrtime(true) - $startTime) / 1e6;
            $this->logOperation($clientId, $operation, $elapsed, false, $e);
            
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        } finally {
            $this->pool->release($clientId);
        }
    }
    
    private function handleEncrypt(array $params, string $clientId): string {
        $salt = $params['salt'] ?? random_bytes(16);
        $key = $this->cryptoCtx->deriveKey($salt, "encrypt:$clientId");
        return $this->cryptoCtx->encrypt($params['plaintext'], $key);
    }
    
    private function handleDecrypt(array $params, string $clientId): string {
        $salt = $params['salt'] ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Salt required for decryption');
        $key = $this->cryptoCtx->deriveKey($salt, "encrypt:$clientId");
        return $this->cryptoCtx->decrypt($params['ciphertext'], $key);
    }
    
    private function handleKeyRotation(array $params, string $clientId): array {
        $oldSalt = $params['old_salt'] ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('old_salt required');
        $newSalt = random_bytes(16);
        
        $oldKey = $this->cryptoCtx->deriveKey($oldSalt, "encrypt:$clientId");
        $newKey = $this->cryptoCtx->deriveKey($newSalt, "encrypt:$clientId");
        
        $reencrypted = [];
        foreach ($params['ciphertexts'] as $ct) {
            $plain = $this->cryptoCtx->decrypt($ct, $oldKey);
            $reencrypted[] = $this->cryptoCtx->encrypt($plain, $newKey);
        }
        
        return ['new_salt' => base64_encode($newSalt), 'ciphertexts' => $reencrypted];
    }
    
    private function logOperation(string $clientId, string $op, float $elapsed, bool $success, ?\Throwable $error = null): void {
        $entry = [
            'client' => $clientId,
            'operation' => $op,
            'elapsed_ms' => round($elapsed, 2),
            'success' => $success,
            'timestamp' => date('c')
        ];
        
        if ($error !== null) {
            $entry['error_context'] = $this->buildErrorContext($error);
        }
        
        $this->operationLog[] = $entry;
        
        if (count($this->operationLog) > $this->maxLogEntries) {
            array_shift($this->operationLog);
        }
    }
    
    private function buildErrorContext(\Throwable $error): array {
        $context = [
            'message' => $error->getMessage(),
            'code' => $error->getCode(),
            'trace_summary' => $this->summarizeTrace($error)
        ];
        return $context;
    }
    
    private function summarizeTrace(\Throwable $error): array {
        $frames = [];
        foreach ($error->getTrace() as $frame) {
            $entry = ($frame['class'] ?? '') . '::' . ($frame['function'] ?? '?');
            if (isset($frame['args'])) {
                $argSummary = [];
                foreach ($frame['args'] as $arg) {
                    $argSummary[] = $this->describeArg($arg);
                }
                $entry .= '(' . implode(', ', $argSummary) . ')';
            }
            $frames[] = $entry;
        }
        return $frames;
    }
    
    private function describeArg(mixed $arg): string {
        if (is_string($arg)) {
            if (strlen($arg) > 64) {
                return 'string(' . strlen($arg) . ')="' . substr($arg, 0, 32) . '..."';
            }
            return 'string(' . strlen($arg) . ')="' . $arg . '"';
        }
        if (is_array($arg)) {
            return 'array(' . count($arg) . ')';
        }
        if (is_object($arg)) {
            return get_class($arg);
        }
        return gettype($arg) . '(' . var_export($arg, true) . ')';
    }
    
    public function getOperationLog(): array {
        return $this->operationLog;
    }
}

class Connection {
    private string $id;
    private bool $alive = true;
    
    public function __construct(string $id) {
        $this->id = $id;
    }
    
    public function isAlive(): bool {
        return $this->alive;
    }
    
    public function close(): void {
        $this->alive = false;
    }
}

class CryptoException extends \RuntimeException {}
